assignment.title: Four-skill practice, transfer and delayed return
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: answer “What limitation does Leo have?” from the recording before reading the script. Save the listening result separately.

READ: answer the gist and detail questions, and mark the exact phrase that proves each answer. Save the reading result separately.

SPEAK: Ask a colleague to swap shifts and agree on a complete solution. Record an independent first attempt, then improve one feature.

WRITE: Write a team message confirming a schedule change. Draft without the model, then revise for reader, purpose, essential detail and next action.

TRANSFER: Your colleague can cover only half of the shift; negotiate the remaining hours.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: Use a conditional om-sentence again in a study-planning task.
assignment.model:
SPEAKING MODEL: Kan vi byta arbetspass på fredag? Jag kan ta ditt morgonpass om du tar min kväll. Bra, då arbetar jag på morgonen och du på kvällen. Jag bekräftar ändringen för chefen.

WRITING MODEL: Hej! Sara och jag har bytt arbetspass på fredag. Jag tar morgonpasset och Sara tar kvällen. Chefen har godkänt ändringen och schemat är uppdaterat.

takeaways: Register: Kan du ta min kväll på fredag? → Kan du ta mitt kvällspass på fredag?
A workplace agreement is complete only when time, person and responsibility are clear.
